gust.method: wind-stratified ratio vs hours with no streak within 1500 km; day-block bootstrap, 98.3% intervals (90% across the 6 categories tested); a change under 3% is not applied

stj.method: latitude of the 250 hPa zonal-wind maximum 15-38 N, averaged 120-80 W (NCEP/NCAR reanalysis monthly means)
